products.name: Petrified Wood Coffee Table — Grande
products.shortDesc: A commanding centrepiece carved from a single ancient wood slab.
products.description: Sourced from 10–20 million year old petrified wood from the volcanic regions of Indonesia, this coffee table is a one-of-a-kind geological treasure. Each piece reveals unique crystalline mineral patterns formed over millennia. The natural edge is preserved and gently polished to a silken finish, mounted on solid iron or custom wood legs.
products.dimensions: W 120 cm × D 70 cm × H 40 cm (custom sizes available)

products.name: Petrified Wood Side Table
products.shortDesc: A sculptural accent piece with striking agate-like patterning.
products.description: This elegant side table showcases a cross-section of ancient petrified wood revealing layers of amber, sienna, and deep espresso minerals. Perfect as a bedside companion or accent table beside a sofa. Each piece is unique — no two are alike.

products.name: Console Table — Petrified Slab
products.shortDesc: Long-form natural slab console with a dramatic live edge.
products.description: A striking statement piece for entryways and living spaces. The live-edge petrified wood slab retains its original organic silhouette, with visible wood grain transformed to mineral crystal over millions of years. Mounted on blackened steel legs for a refined industrial contrast.
products.dimensions: W 160 cm × D 40 cm × H 80 cm

products.name: TV Media Console
products.shortDesc: Low-profile TV stand with organic petrified wood top.
products.description: Functional meets fossil. This media console features a petrified wood slab top with storage compartments below, crafted from reclaimed teak or iron. The contrast of ancient stone-like wood with modern compartments creates a uniquely grounding presence in any living space.
products.dimensions: W 180 cm × D 45 cm × H 45 cm

products.name: Grand Dining Table — River Slab
products.shortDesc: An heirloom dining table hewn from a single river-bed petrified slab.
products.description: The centrepiece of extraordinary dining rooms. This monumental dining table is shaped from a rare river-bed petrified wood slab, offering a dramatic natural-edge silhouette and breathtaking mineral banding. Seats 8–10 comfortably. Each table takes weeks to prepare and is truly one of a kind.
products.material: Petrified Wood, Iron or Steel Legs
products.dimensions: W 260 cm × D 100 cm × H 76 cm

products.name: Dining Table — Oval Slab
products.shortDesc: Oval-form petrified wood table, ideal for intimate dining.
products.description: The rounded silhouette of this oval petrified wood dining table softens its immense natural presence. Accommodating 4–6 guests, it works beautifully in both spacious dining rooms and smaller settings where drama is desired without overwhelming scale.
products.dimensions: W 180 cm × D 90 cm × H 76 cm

products.name: Dining Bench — Slab Seat
products.shortDesc: Long petrified wood slab bench for communal dining.
products.description: Pair with our dining tables or use as a standalone garden bench. The thick petrified wood slab seat offers a dramatic surface of fossilised grain patterns. Iron legs provide stable support for the considerable weight of this magnificent bench.
products.dimensions: W 180 cm × D 35 cm × H 45 cm

products.name: Petrified Wood Nightstand
products.shortDesc: A sculptural bedside companion with organic presence.
products.description: Bring the beauty of ancient earth into your bedroom sanctuary. This nightstand features a petrified wood slab top with a hand-crafted storage drawer below. The warm amber and espresso tones of the ancient wood create a calming, grounding bedside presence.
products.dimensions: W 50 cm × D 40 cm × H 55 cm

products.name: Bedroom Accent Table
products.shortDesc: Round petrified wood slab on a minimal tripod base.
products.description: A versatile accent table suited for bedroom corners, vanity areas, or as a plant stand. The circular cross-section reveals beautiful growth-ring mineral patterns reminiscent of ancient agate. Mounted on a slim brass or iron tripod base.

products.name: Garden Dining Table
products.shortDesc: Weatherproof petrified wood table for tropical outdoor living.
products.description: Petrified wood is naturally stone — it does not absorb moisture, resist rot, and withstands the tropical climate of Bali beautifully. This outdoor dining table is a statement in any garden, terrace, or pool area. Paired with our matching bench or custom iron chairs.
products.dimensions: W 200 cm × D 90 cm × H 76 cm

products.name: Garden Bench
products.shortDesc: Chunky solid petrified wood outdoor bench, timeless and durable.
products.description: A single thick slab of petrified wood forms both seat and back support in this garden bench. As strong as stone and as beautiful as art, it will outlast generations. Suitable for garden paths, terraces, poolside, and temple gardens.
products.dimensions: W 150 cm × D 40 cm × H 45 cm

products.name: Decorative Wood Slice — Wall Art
products.shortDesc: A full cross-section slice of petrified wood, ideal for wall display.
products.description: Each decorative slice is a window into geological time. The cross-section of an ancient tree reveals intricate annual ring patterns transformed over millions of years into mineral crystal. Polished to a mirror sheen on one face, natural on the reverse. Comes with hanging hardware.

products.name: Bookends — Petrified Wood Pair
products.shortDesc: Matching pair of petrified wood bookends with natural edge.
products.description: These solid bookends are cut from the same piece of petrified wood to ensure matching grain patterns. Heavy enough to hold the largest book collections, beautiful enough to display as sculpture. Available in a range of colour profiles.
products.dimensions: W 12 cm × D 10 cm × H 18 cm (per piece)

products.name: Pedestal Display Stand
products.shortDesc: Tall cylindrical petrified wood pedestal for sculpture or plants.
products.description: A pedestal that is itself a work of art. This tall cylindrical column of petrified wood features dramatic vertical grain patterning and can be used as a sculpture stand, plant display, or accent column. Each piece is structurally unique.

products.name: Candle Holder Set
products.shortDesc: Set of 3 small petrified wood candle holders, graduated heights.
products.description: A set of three turned petrified wood candle holders in graduated heights, perfect for table centrepieces and mantle displays. The warm amber glow of candlelight against the crystalline wood surface creates a magical atmosphere.
